metadata.description: ShipShape — quality gates that catch real defects, enforced by hooks that read evidence artifacts instead of transcript prose.

plugins.name: shipshape
plugins.description: Quality gates that catch real defects, enforced by hooks that read evidence artifacts instead of transcript prose. A Claude Code-only take on obra/superpowers, written for Opus 5 / Fable 5 and long-context solo work.

plugins.name: shipdeck
plugins.description: ShipShape's companion mod: refines dictated prompts before the session reads them, keeps a band above the prompt with the session's seat, context and evidence, and lists your sessions in a pane. Reads and displays; never gates. Needs Claude Code 2.1.309 or later.
